settings.title: Settings
settings.theme.title: Theme
settings.theme.description: Pick a UI color mode. System mode follows your OS dark/light setting automatically.
settings.provider.title: Default provider
settings.provider.description: Pick which AI to use by default. Changes apply to new messages immediately.
settings.permission.title: Default permission
settings.permission.description: Permission level new sessions inherit. Per-session permission can be changed in the chat header.
settings.permission.empty_custom: Configured via user grants (UI coming in v0.13.0).
settings.permission.hint.read_only: Read files only. Writes/executes are blocked (approval modal coming in v1.1.0).
settings.permission.hint.workspace_write: Recommended. Free read/write/execute inside the workspace folder.
settings.permission.hint.full_access: Allows access outside the folder + uploads. Use carefully.
settings.permission.hint.custom: Allow capabilities only via user grants. Grant management UI coming in v1.1.0 — currently most capabilities are blocked.
settings.permission.grant_status_title: ⚠ Approval modal / grant management UI coming in v1.1.0
settings.permission.grant_status_body: Capabilities blocked by the current default level are denied immediately (no user confirmation modal). v1.1.0 will add the approval modal + add/revoke grant UI.
settings.onboarding.title: Onboarding
settings.onboarding.description: Replay the 5-step welcome guide. Existing sessions and settings are kept.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.description: Pick the UI display language. Changes apply across the app immediately.
settings.diagnose.title: Database diagnostics
settings.diagnose.description: Inspect SQLite native module, database integrity, and runtime info. If anything is wrong, follow the hints below.
settings.diagnose.error.title: Diagnostic error
settings.diagnose.error.db_load_failed: Failed to load the database module.
settings.diagnose.hint.heading: Troubleshooting
settings.diagnose.hint.line1: Run `npm run diagnose` in the terminal for detailed output.
settings.diagnose.hint.line2: If you suspect ABI mismatch, run `npm run dev:rebuild` and restart the app.
settings.diagnose.audit.title: Audit log
settings.diagnose.audit.description: Tool executions and permission decisions are recorded automatically in audit_log (v1.0.11 SEC-3). Showing the latest 50 events.
settings.diagnose.audit.empty: No audit events yet. They appear after tool executions or session creation.
settings.diagnose.audit.error.title: Failed to load audit log
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.description: Shows app name, version, license, code signing status, and auto-update status.
settings.about.signing.unsigned_hint: v1.0.0 is unsigned. After certificates are purchased, v1.0.1+ activates automatically (see docs/code-signing.md).
settings.about.auto_update.enabled_hint: electron-updater polls GitHub Releases. Background-download on detect, install on next quit.
settings.about.footer.thanks: v1.0.0 — thanks for trying Dreampia-Dev. Issues, discussions, and PRs welcome.
